response_text:
The Italian translation of **"Happy birthday!"** is:

**"Buon compleanno!"** (pronounced *bwohn kom-PLAY-noh*)

If you want to be even more formal or polite, you could say:
**"Auguri di buon compleanno!"** (*aw-GOO-ree dee bwohn kom-PLAY-noh*)

For a group, you can add **"a tutti"** (*ah TOO-ee*) at the end:
**"Buon compleanno a tutti!"** (*bwohn kom-PLAY-noh ah TOO-ee!*)

Happy birthday! 🎉🎂
